mapper.select: SELECT M.PAY_YM, M.EMP_NO, I.ITEM_CD, NVL(I.ITEM_AMT, 0) AS ITEM_AMT FROM PAY_MONTH M, PAY_ITEM I WHERE M.PAY_YM = I.PAY_YM(+) AND M.EMP_NO = I.EMP_NO(+) AND M.PAY_YM = #{payYm}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PAY_MONTH T USING (SELECT #{payYm} AS PAY_YM, #{empNo} AS EMP_NO, SUM(ITEM_AMT) AS AMT FROM PAY_ITEM WHERE PAY_YM = #{payYm} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}) S ON (T.PAY_YM = S.PAY_YM AND T.EMP_NO = S.EMP_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.TOT_PAY_AMT = S.AMT, T.NET_PAY_AMT = S.AMT - T.TOT_DED_AMT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PAY_YM, EMP_NO, TOT_PAY_AMT, NET_PAY_AMT) VALUES (S.PAY_YM, S.EMP_NO, S.AMT, S.AMT)
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PAY_HIST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PAY_HIST (HIST_ID, PAY_YM, EMP_NO, CHG_DESC, REG_DT) VALUES (#{histId}, #{payYm}, #{empNo}, #{chgDesc}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE PAY_MONTH SET CLOSE_YN = 'Y' WHERE PAY_YM = #{payYm}
